content.json: Cross-environment view for the Origination Workbench. Overview is the quick read; the other tabs hold history. Deeper App Insights views and the in-app Usage Dashboard (adoption) are linked at the bottom.

parameters.name: Environment
parameters.label: Environment
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites' and name startswith 'app-origination' and name endswith '-eus'
| extend label = case(name endswith '-dev-eus', 'Dev', name endswith '-qa-eus', 'QA', 'Production')
| extend sortKey = case(label == 'Production', 0, label == 'QA', 1, 2)
| project value = id, label, sortKey
| order by sortKey asc

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.label: ResourceGroup
parameters.query: resources | where id =~ '{Environment}' | project value = resourceGroup, label = resourceGroup, selected = true

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.label: SubscriptionId

parameters.name: AppInsights
parameters.label: AppInsights

content.query:
union
  (requests | where timestamp {TimeRange} | summarize Value = toreal(count()) | extend Metric = "Requests", Order = 1),
  (requests | where timestamp {TimeRange} | summarize Value = toreal(countif(success == false)) | extend Metric = "Failed requests", Order = 2),
  (requests | where timestamp {TimeRange} | summarize Value = round(100.0 * countif(success == false) / max_of(count(), 1), 2) | extend Metric = "Failure %", Order = 3),
  (requests | where timestamp {TimeRange} | summarize Value = toreal(round(percentile(duration, 95))) | extend Metric = "p95 response ms", Order = 4),
  (exceptions | where timestamp {TimeRange} | summarize Value = toreal(count()) | extend Metric = "Exceptions", Order = 5),
  (dependencies | where timestamp {TimeRange} | summarize Value = toreal(countif(success == false)) | extend Metric = "Failed integration calls", Order = 6)
| order by Order asc
| project Metric, Value
content.title: At a glance — {TimeRange:label}
content.noDataMessage: No request telemetry in this range.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests = count(), Failed = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Requests and failures over time
content.noDataMessage: No request telemetry in this range.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} and success == false
| summarize Failures = count(), Last = max(timestamp) by Endpoint = name, Code = tostring(resultCode)
| top 8 by Failures desc
content.title: Top failing endpoints
content.noDataMessage: No failed requests in this range.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Calls = count(), P95ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by Endpoint = name
| where Calls >= 5
| top 8 by P95ms desc
content.title: Slowest endpoints (p95, at least 5 calls)
content.noDataMessage: No request telemetry in this range.

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| where resourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| extend Fired = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime),
         Severity = tostring(properties.essentials.severity),
         Condition = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition),
         State = tostring(properties.essentials.alertState),
         Target = tostring(properties.essentials.targetResourceName)
| project Fired, Alert = name, Severity, Condition, State, Target
| order by Fired desc
content.title: Alerts, last 30 days
content.noDataMessage: No alerts fired in the last 30 days.

content.query:
resources
| where id =~ '{Environment}'
| project Name = name, State = tostring(properties.state), Runtime = tostring(properties.siteConfig.linuxFxVersion),
          ConfigChanged = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedTimeUtc)
content.title: Web app

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/certificates' and resourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| extend Expires = todatetime(properties.expirationDate)
| extend DaysLeft = datetime_diff('day', Expires, now())
| project Hosts = strcat_array(properties.hostNames, ", "), Issuer = tostring(properties.issuer), Expires, DaysLeft
| order by Expires asc
content.title: TLS certificate

content.query:
union
  (traces | project timestamp, severityLevel, message),
  (exceptions | project timestamp, severityLevel = toint(3), message = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.FormattedMessage), outerMessage))
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "CustomerSync completed" or (message has "CustomerSync" and severityLevel >= 3)
| parse message with "CustomerSync completed in " ElapsedMs:long " ms. Customers: " CustInserted:long " inserted, " CustUpdated:long " updated, " CustReactivated:long " reactivated, " CustDeactivated:long " deactivated. TradeUnits: " TuInserted:long " inserted, " TuUpdated:long " updated, " TuDeactivated:long " deactivated. " *
| project Ran = timestamp,
          Outcome = iff(severityLevel >= 3, "Failed", "Completed"),
          Seconds = round(ElapsedMs / 1000.0, 1),
          CustDeactivated, TuDeactivated,
          Detail = iff(severityLevel >= 3, message, "")
| order by Ran desc
| take 1

content.query:
union
  (traces | project timestamp, severityLevel, message),
  (exceptions | project timestamp, severityLevel = toint(3), message = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.FormattedMessage), outerMessage))
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "Aggregation cycle completed"
     or message startswith "Aggregated weekly logins"
     or message startswith "Refreshed trade unit snapshot"
     or message startswith "Failed to refresh trade unit snapshot"
     or message startswith "Retention cleanup"
     or message startswith "Error during aggregation cycle"
     or message startswith "Backfilled usage rollups"
     or message startswith "Error processing usage tracking batch"
     or message startswith "Error flushing final usage tracking batch"
     or message startswith "CTRM keep-warm: maintained"
     or (message startswith "CTRM keep-warm" and severityLevel >= 2)
| extend Job = case(message startswith "CTRM keep-warm", "CTRM keep-warm",
                    message startswith "Retention cleanup", "Retention cleanup",
                    message has "usage tracking batch", "Usage tracking (click capture)",
                    "Usage rollups")
| extend Outcome = case(severityLevel >= 3, "Failed", severityLevel == 2, "Warning", "Completed")
| project Ran = timestamp, Job, Outcome, Message = message
| order by Ran desc
| take 100
content.title: Other background jobs — usage rollups, usage tracking, retention, CTRM keep-warm
content.noDataMessage: No job completions in this range. Usage rollups run hourly; CTRM keep-warm runs continuously while CTRM is enabled.

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend Integration = case(
    type == "SQL" and target has "ODS", "ODS (SQL, read-only views)",
    type == "SQL" and target has "Origination", "Origination DB (SQL)",
    type == "SQL" and target has "TradeUnitPreferences", "Trade Unit Preferences (SQL)",
    type == "SQL", strcat("SQL: ", target),
    name has "graphql" or target has "api.scoular.com" or target has "apiqa.scoular.com", "CTRM GraphQL (Scoular API gateway)",
    target has "graph.microsoft.com", "Microsoft Graph",
    target has "vault.azure.net", "Key Vault",
    target has "login.microsoftonline.com", "Entra ID",
    target has "cognitiveservices.azure.com" or target has "openai.azure.com", "Azure OpenAI",
    strcat(type, ": ", target))
| summarize Calls = count(), Failed = countif(success == false),
            P50ms = round(percentile(duration, 50)), P95ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)), MaxMs = round(max(duration)),
            Last = max(timestamp) by Integration
| extend FailPct = round(100.0 * Failed / Calls, 2)
| project Integration, Calls, Failed, FailPct, P50ms, P95ms, MaxMs, Last
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Integrations — calls, failure rate and latency in the selected range
content.noDataMessage: No dependency telemetry in this range.
